item.title: AI Agents Are Media’s New Favorite Audience
item.description: As agents go mainstream, some publishers are hoping that people will pay for content tailor-made for AI—not humans.

item.title: I Tested Every Major AI Agent for a Day. Here’s the Best One
item.description: I ranked six AI agents—from Meta’s Muse to Anthropic’s Claude Duet—on how well they completed basic tasks.

item.title: Why Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Is Missing So Many Key Figures
item.description: Anthropic’s S-1 filing is hundreds of pages long—and it leaves out quite a few financial details. “Anthropic owes investors more information,” one analyst tells WIRED.

item.title: The Anthropic S-1 Filing Is Also an AI Doomsday Primer
item.description: Anthropic thinks “closing the loop” is the best path to AI triumph—and a recipe for “existential” threats to humanity.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
item.description: Anthropic on Monday filed documents ahead of a blockbuster IPO that offers insight into the company’s financials, risk factors, and views on the future of AI.

item.title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
item.description: Jayden, Sam, and Zack are eagerly pitching editors on reported stories and investigative features. The catch? They're all AI agents.

item.title: This AI Radio Host Speaks Spanish and Backs Immigrants. It’s Winning Over Listeners
item.description: Coyotec is bilingual, swears, and tells listeners how to defend themselves against ICE. Its popularity comes as more broadcasters are experimenting with artificial personalities.

item.title: What the US Movement Against Data Centers Can Learn From Abroad
item.description: Paris Marx, author of Hyperscale, has been tracking global data center development for years. The US has a lot to learn from what’s happened everywhere from Ireland to New Zealand.

item.title: The PHP Meltdown Shows How AI Makes Bugs More Exploitable
item.description: Security researchers used AI tools to help uncover years-old vulnerabilities in the PHP web scripting language. Then the AI-assisted attacks began.

item.title: The Social Society Helping Women Join the AI Boom
item.description: WIRED spoke with the founders of the Aged Intelligence Society, a fast-growing events startup that brings women together to “solve midlife problems using frontier tools.”
